description: A {from: ...} param only resolves to its real value at dispatch time -- the compile-time check of a generated document's text sees only the raw {from: ...} leaf, never what it resolves to, so it can't catch a service start whose resolved executable isn't allowed. The dispatch-time check (#772) catches it right before this attempt would otherwise run, against the fully rendered params, and the failure is never retried even though retries are configured.
